item.title: Free Ukrainian Easter Egg Decorating workshop at First Presbyterian Church in Elkhart
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- First Presbyterian Church in Elkhart announced it's offering a free Ukrainian Easter Egg Decorating workshop, also known as pysanky.

item.title: La Casa de Amistad offers school vaccinations for children
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- A vaccine clinic will be held at La Casa de Amistad for children and youth who need their required school vaccinations.

item.title: Neighbors and non-profits work to clear out storm damage
item.description: THREE RIVERS, Mich. — A number of non-profits from throughout the country are gathered in southwest Michigan right now, working alongside neighbors to pick up the pieces after Friday's tornadoes.

item.title: Tornado Safety: Where to go in a Big Box Store?
item.description: THREE RIVERS, Mich -- An EF-2 Tornado with wind up to 130 mph hit the local Manard's store just before 4:00 PM Friday, while customers were inside. The roof ripped off and an exterior wall partially collapsed.

item.title: The EF Tornado Rating Scale
item.description: THREE RIVERS, Mich -- The Enhanced Fujita Scale is used to rate the strength of tornadoes based on observed damage.

item.title: Premier Arts kicks off season with Seussical the Musical
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Premier Arts is performing Seussical the Musical at the Lerner Theatre to kick off their 18th season and to celebrate Love to Read month.

item.title: Woman charged with Identity Deception after report to DCS
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- St. Joseph County prosecutors have charged 45-year-old Gloria Niedbalski with Identity Deception, a level six felony, and False Informing, a misdemeanor.

item.title: Juvenile sentenced to four years for Dangerous Possession of a Firearm
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- According to court documents, one of the two juveniles charged for illegally possessing a firearm has been sentenced for Dangerous Possession of a Firearm, a Level Five Felony.

item.title: Starke County crash leaves two motorcyclists injured, airlifted to hospital
item.description: STARKE COUNTY, Ind. -- According to the Starke County Sherif's Office, at approximately 5:08 p.m. on Monday, March 9, officers responded to a personal injury crash at the intersection of US Highway 35 and C.R. 250 South.

item.title: District outlines plan for federal education funding
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The board of School Trustees listened in on a presentation on Monday night about the title funding update.
